description: This file defines the VirtualQuotaFallbackHandler class, which manages multiple API handlers with quota limits, providing fallback mechanisms when limits are reached. It handles profile loading, handler switching, error detection, and message creation for API requests.

classes.name: VirtualQuotaFallbackHandler
classes.description: Manages multiple API handlers with quota limits, providing fallback when limits are reached, handling profile loading, handler switching, and message creation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the handler by loading profiles and setting up the active handler.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in the provided content using the active handler.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream, handling retries and quota management.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns model information from the active handler.

methods.name: getActiveProfileNumber
methods.description: Returns the index of the current active profile.

methods.name: contextWindow
methods.description: Returns the context window size of the active model.

methods.name: loadConfiguredProfiles
methods.description: Loads profiles from settings and initializes API handlers.

methods.name: adjustActiveHandler
methods.description: Selects the appropriate handler based on quota and cooldown status.

methods.name: notifyHandlerSwitch
methods.description: Displays a message when switching handlers or when no handler is available.

methods.name: isRateLimitError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a rate limit error.

methods.name: isOverloadError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a server overload (503).

methods.name: underLimit
methods.description: Checks if a profile is within its quota limits.
